programs.title: Jake Makes It Easy

programs.desc: John is a sweet guy trying to get over his bumpy past, but not as bumpy as the huge growth on his shoulder. Tami has yellow deposits on her eyelids that make it impossible for her to feel beautiful.

programs.title: Our Dead Husband
programs.desc: When Kris discovers her husband Ritchie shot dead in their home, she assumes it has to do with his work in high-level intelligence. But she then learns that his missions were a cover for a secret family.

programs.title: Surviving The Sleepover
